releaseNotes:
✨ What's New in Release v2.1.81:
- 📥 Import Bot Fleet: import bots easily from JSON backup or pasted token lists
- 📤 Export Bot Fleet: 1-tap export with Copy to Clipboard, Share via Apps, and Save to Downloads
- 💾 Full Database Persistence: all bots are immediately saved to Room DB and synced to cloud
- 🛡️ Uninstall/Reinstall Zero-Data-Loss fix: profile, master keys, bot fleet & cloud files perfectly restored on login
